description: This file defines the PartitionEndpointProvider class, which manages AWS endpoint partition selections based on regions, services, and options. It includes methods for obtaining partitions, merging endpoint data, and providing a default provider.

classes.name: PartitionEndpointProvider
classes.description: A class responsible for providing AWS endpoint partitions based on region, service, and options, including methods for fallback and merging prefix data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a list of partitions, default partition name, and options.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Callable method that returns the appropriate partition for the specified region and service.

methods.name: getPartition
methods.description: Returns the partition matching the provided region and service, or the default if no match.

methods.name: getPartitionByName
methods.description: Retrieves a partition by its name.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default provider using embedded JSON data for partitions.

methods.name: mergePrefixData
methods.description: Merges prefix-specific endpoint data into the partition data.
